name: Vanilla Latte
caffeineNote: Not published by the brand or its listings
summary: Vietnamese cà phê sữa sold as a vanilla latte: concentrated Da Lat and Colombian arabica over non-dairy creamer and milk powders, aseptically filled so it keeps without preservatives. King Coffee publishes an 8.04 oz can and a $19.99 six-pack but no nutrition panel, so those columns stay blank until we check a can.
